_meta.description: Curated public interest-incidence rates for Constanza's audience layer (app/services/constanza_audience.py). Deliberately small — every entry needs an actual cited source; an interest phrase that doesn't map to one of these returns 'unsupported_trait' rather than an invented rate. See the Phase 2 plan doc.
_meta.policy: No rate ships without a source + source_date. Extend by adding entries here, not by asking the LLM to estimate a rate.

categories.label: Sports fan (general)
categories.source: Gallup, 'As Industry Grows, Percentage of U.S. Sports Fans Steady' + Gallup Sports historical trend (68% of Americans self-identify as a fan of at least one sport, stable 2023-2026)
categories.sample_scope: US adults, general population. Gallup reports men as more likely to be fans than women, but did not publish an exact gender split in the sources checked — the same 68% rate is applied to all genders here rather than inventing a split percentage; a confirmed gender-specific split would tighten this.

categories.label: Plays video games (weekly)
categories.source: Entertainment Software Association (ESA) 2025 Essential Facts report, conducted with YouGov — 60% of US adults play video games weekly; 52% of male / 47% of female adults play weekly
categories.sample_scope: US adults 18+, general population. Age-band-specific rates aren't modeled in v1 (ESA's report shows the gender skew reverses for older cohorts — boomer women play more than boomer men — but that nuance isn't encoded here yet); the flat gender rate is applied across all ages.
